content.comment_body: Testing [product_name] App on Android, I created a custom page with a dial gauge control. I added the 'Outside temperature' tag (signed word value) to the device overview. Everything worked fine initially. On the custom control page, I tried adding the gauge, setting minimum and maximum values (50 and 70), as well as warning and danger levels. After selecting the PLC and the 'Outside temperature' tag, I saved the settings. The actual temperature was 1.8 degrees, but the tag value was 18, so the gauge showed 18 degrees. However, there's no option to display decimal points like on the BM display or [product_name] operator panel. Is there really no way to add a decimal point for the tag value display? The [product_name] App has been around for years—hard to believe controls like Gauge or Analog bar graph only show raw values, without configurable decimal points.
What kind of answer are you hoping for from the community?
Am I missing something? Maybe I haven't checked in the right place. It’s hard to believe I'm the only one wanting to display temperature with a decimal point in the [product_name] App.
Consider contacting [company_name] directly via a support request...
I believe development on the [product_name] App stopped some years ago. You can use it as it is, but creating pages with [product_name] Editor should work better.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience a limitation in the [product_name] App, where numerical values like temperature are shown without decimal points, causing less accurate or clear readings (e.g., 1.8°C displayed as 18). This problem is noticeable with visual controls such as gauges. Users express surprise and frustration that the decimal point configuration available on other operator devices is missing here, considering the app's longstanding development.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to set decimal point positions for variables in the app, similar to how it works on operator panels or other interfaces from [company_name].
